info.name: Gemini Notebook API v1 by useapi.net
info.description:
## [Gemini Notebook API v1](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1)

Google Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) API by useapi.net: notebooks, sources (including Google Drive), grounded chat (history, settings), notes (incl. mind map notes), source labels, notebook copy and guide, sharing, Discover sources and Deep Research, and Studio artifacts (audio and video overviews, slides, reports, quizzes, flashcards, infographics, mind maps). Set the `api-token` collection variable (see https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-useapi). Request bodies are sent as form-data, except POST sources, POST chat, POST sharing, POST notes/mindmap, POST labels/{label}, POST research, POST research/import and POST artifacts, which send JSON because they take arrays; the API accepts JSON for every body. POST sources/upload sends the file itself as the body.

---
**Updated:** September 28, 2026

## [Add sources](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-sources)

**Body (JSON).** Provide `urls`, `text`, `drive`, `books` or any combination.

- `notebook` (required): notebook id.
- `urls`: array of 1-50 http(s) URLs. youtube.com / youtu.be links are added as YouTube sources, anything else as a web page. Google reads a YouTube video from its captions: a video without any ends with status error (upload the audio or video file instead).
- `text`: pasted text added as one source, up to 500,000 chars.
- `title`: title of the pasted text source (text only), up to 200 chars. Default `Pasted text`.
- `drive`: array of 1-50 Google Drive files `{ fileId, mimeType, name }`, all required. A Google Doc is `application/vnd.google-apps.document`. Send the exact MIME type: a wrong one changes how Google reads the file. The account must be able to open the file in its Drive (else 409).
- `books`: array of 1-20 Google Play Books ids from GET sources/books. The account must own each book and its publisher must allow it (`addable: true`), else 404 / 422 and nothing is added. Each book becomes one source of kind `book`.

header.description: The file's MIME type: application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document (.docx), application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation (.pptx), application/epub+zip, text/markdown, text/plain, text/csv, audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/wav, video/mp4, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp.

query.description: Required. Notebook id to add the file to.
Optional. File name with extension (e.g. apollo11-overview.docx), up to 200 chars; Google uses it as the source title and types the file by it. Default upload.<ext> from Content-Type.

## [Retrieve a source](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/get-gemini-notebook-sources-source)

The source plus Google's `summary` and key `topics`, `inSync` for Google Drive sources, and with `content=true` the text Google indexed. Those fields appear once the source is `ready`.

## [Sync a Google Drive source](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-sources-sync)

Re-imports a Google Drive source (kind `google_docs` or `drive`) when its file changed in Drive. Returns the source with `synced` true or false. Checking a changed Google Doc (GET sources/{{source}}) can itself start Google's re-import, so a sync right after may answer `synced: false` with the new text already in. Usually answers within 1-2 minutes. If Google takes longer the API answers 504 after about 2 minutes and the sync usually still completes: check GET sources/{{source}} before retrying.

formdata.description: Required. A Google Drive source id.

query.description: Optional with a single account, required otherwise.

## [Ask a question](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-chat)

**Body (JSON).**

- `notebook` (required): notebook id.
- `question` (required): 1-10,000 chars.
- `conversation` (optional): the `conversation` id from an earlier answer in this notebook, to ask a follow-up.
- `sources` (optional): array of 1-300 source ids from this notebook to answer from. Default: every ready source.

Follow-up example: `{"notebook": "{{notebook}}", "question": "...", "conversation": "<uuid>", "sources": ["{{source}}"]}`

query.description: Optional. Conversation id. Default: the latest conversation.

## [Create a mind map note](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-notes-mindmap)

**Body (JSON).** One call, not a job: returns the new note (type mindmap) and its JSON `tree`.

- `notebook` (required): notebook id.
- `sources`: 1-300 source ids. Default: every ready source.
- `language`: e.g. `en` (default), `es`, `pt_BR`.
- `instructions`: what to focus on, up to 10,000 chars.
## [Retrieve sharing](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/get-gemini-notebook-sharing)

## [Share a notebook](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-sharing)

**Body (JSON).** Provide `people`, `link`, `allowCopies`, `viewLevel` or any combination. Returns the sharing after the change.

- `notebook` (required): notebook id.
- `people`: array of 1-50 `{ email, role }`, role `viewer`, `editor` or `remove`. The owner cannot be changed.
- `link`: `public` (anyone with the link) or `restricted`.
- `allowCopies`: true or false, public link only (not with `link: restricted`, which resets it to allowed).
- `notify`: false skips Google's share email. Default true.
- `viewLevel`: `full` or `chat` (viewers get the chat only). Paid Google plans only (403 on a free account). Echoed in the response.

Provide `auto` or `name`. `auto: all` labels every source and replaces all labels (new ids), `auto: unlabeled` labels only sources without one. `name` (+ `emoji`) adds an empty label of your own. Returns the whole label set.

## [Generate an artifact](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-artifacts)

**Body (JSON).** `type` is required. With `notebook` the artifact is generated in that notebook (optionally from `sources`); without `notebook` it is a one-shot request: a new notebook is created from `urls` and/or `text` on `email` (or a load-balanced account). The example is a valid `audio` request on a notebook with every audio option at its default.

- `type` (required): `audio`, `video`, `report`, `interactive_report`, `table`, `quiz`, `flashcards`, `infographic`, `slides`, `mindmap`
- `notebook`: notebook id. Omit for one-shot.
- `sources`: with `notebook` only. Array of 1-300 source ids from that notebook. Default: every ready source.
- `urls`: one-shot only. Array of 1-50 http(s) URLs (youtube.com / youtu.be become YouTube sources).
- `text`: one-shot only. Pasted text source, up to 500,000 chars.
- `title`: one-shot only. The new notebook's title (and the pasted text's title), up to 200 chars.
- `email`: one-shot only. Account to run on; auto-picked when omitted.
- `deleteNotebook`: one-shot only. `true` deletes the notebook when the job ends. Only for `report`, `interactive_report`, `table`, `quiz`, `flashcards`, `mindmap`.
- `mode`: `sync` (default) or `async`. `replyUrl`: webhook URL. `replyRef`: up to 1024 chars.

**Options by type** (default first; an option not listed for a type returns 400):

- `audio`: `format` deep_dive | brief | critique | debate; `length` default | short | long; `language`; `instructions`
- `video`: `format` explainer | brief | cinematic | short; `style` auto | classic | whiteboard | heritage | paper_craft | watercolor | anime | retro_print | kawaii | custom; `stylePrompt` (up to 2,000 chars, required with style custom and only then); `language`; `instructions`. `cinematic` takes no style, instructions or language; `short` takes no style.
- `report`: `format` briefing | study_guide | blog_post | custom; `language`; `instructions` (required with format custom, where it is the whole prompt; with a preset format it is added to the preset's prompt)
- `interactive_report`: `language`, `instructions`
- `table`: `language`; `instructions`
- `quiz`, `flashcards`: `quantity` standard | fewer | more; `difficulty` medium | easy | hard; `instructions`
- `infographic`: `orientation` landscape | portrait | square; `detail` standard | concise | detailed; `style` auto | sketch_note | professional | bento_grid | editorial | instructional | bricks | clay | anime | kawaii | scientific; `language`; `instructions`
- `slides`: `format` detailed | presenter; `length` default | short | long; `language`; `instructions`
- `mindmap`: `instructions`

`language` is a code such as `en` (default), `es`, `pt_BR`, `zh_Hans`. `instructions` is up to 10,000 chars.
## [Retry a failed artifact](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-artifacts-retry)

formdata.description: Required. Id of the failed artifact.
Optional. sync (default, waits up to 90 s: 200 when done, 202 with the job record while still running) or async (201 + jobid at once; poll GET /jobs/{jobid}).
Optional. Public http(s) webhook URL; the job record is POSTed to it once when the job completes or fails.
Optional. Your own reference echoed back in the job record, up to 1024 chars.

## [Generate a suggested item](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-artifacts-generate)

**Body (JSON).** `artifact` is required: an item from an interactive report's `embedded` list with status `suggested`. Optional `instructions` plus the options of its type (infographic, slides, mindmap, quiz, flashcards). `mode`, `replyUrl`, `replyRef` as in POST artifacts.

## [Export an artifact](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-artifacts-export)

**Body (JSON).** `artifact` and `destination` are required: `docs` for a `report`, `sheets` for a `table`. `title` is optional. Returns the Google Docs or Sheets URL.

## [Copy artifacts](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-artifacts-copy)

**Body (JSON).** `artifacts` (ids from one notebook) and the target `notebook` (same account) are required.

## [Research sources](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-research)

**Body (JSON).** Runs as a job, poll GET jobs/{{jobid}}.

- `notebook` (required): notebook id.
- `query` (required): what to research, 1-2,000 chars.
- `type`: `fast` (Discover sources, default) or `deep` (Deep Research, a Markdown report plus its sources).
- `source`: `web` (default) or `drive` (the account's Google Drive, type fast only).
- `mode`: `sync` (default, waits up to 90 s, then 202) or `async`. `replyUrl`: webhook URL. `replyRef`: up to 1024 chars.

## [Import research results](https://useapi.net/docs/api-gemini-notebook-v1/post-gemini-notebook-research-import)

**Body (JSON).** Adds a completed research job's results to its notebook. Google Drive results (`source: "drive"`) are added as Drive files: a Google Doc as `google_docs`, other files as `drive`. A Drive result with `mimeType: null` answers 400: add it with POST sources and `drive`. Usually answers within 1-2 minutes. If Google takes longer the API answers 504 after about 2 minutes and the import usually still completes: check GET notebooks/{{notebook}} before retrying (a retry adds every source twice).

- `jobid` (required): a completed research job.
- `urls`: up to 500 URLs from the job's `result.sources`, `[]` for none. Default: every cited source.
- `report`: import the Deep Research report. Default true without `urls`, false with `urls`.
